subject: Request: one-off sandbox runway waiver & complimentary credits — Brightfield
messages:
From: Sophie Li <sophie@brightfield.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Brown <ethan@brightfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off sandbox runway waiver & complimentary credits — Brightfield

Connor — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Team loved the latency profile and the caching behavior; the engineers ran a couple of early integrations and we're seeing good alignment with our inference patterns.

We're coming up against our PLG sandbox limits and would like to request a one-off extension and extra credits to finish a deeper evaluation:
- Additional sandbox window: 90 days
- Complimentary credits: $40,000 worth of inference credits (to cover a heavy second-phase test)

We understand these are outside the standard PLG terms. If you can route this to the right people at Redwood (and let us know any hoops like a PO, MOU or data handling agreements), we can move quickly — our CTO wants to present a vendor recommendation at the 10 Sep architecture review.

I've attached a short usage report so you can see expected token volume and peak QPS. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Sophie Li
Head of ML Engineering
Brightfield AI

Attachments: brightfield_usage_q2.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

Subject: Re: Request: one-off sandbox runway waiver & complimentary credits — Brightfield

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for sharing the usage report. Really glad the demo landed well.

I will escalate this to Deal Desk / RevOps for a one-time exception. Two quick contextual notes for Brightfield:
- Standard PLG sandbox: 30 days + $5k credits
- Asking for 90 days and $40k is outside our policy, so I need exec approval (Marissa + Aditya).

Looping Marissa for approval and Aditya for finance/contract steps. I'll include a recommendation below in my note to them.

Connor O'Brien

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie@brightfield.ai>, Ethan Brown <ethan@brightfield.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-off sandbox runway waiver & complimentary credits — Brightfield (recommendation)

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Sophie’s request and the usage report. Key ask: 90-day sandbox + $40k in credits. Context below and my recommended approval path.

Why this matters:
- Brightfield is evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider for their product — low friction, PLG motion with clear path to a paid contract if we can demonstrate integration stability (they expect to move to Dedicated within 6–8 months if eval goes well).
- Their QPS pattern suggests a short period of high token consumption (model warmup + batch scoring) that our caching/quantization recommendations materially reduce — if we can fund the heavy test, we think we can show 35–45% cost savings at scale.

Requested exception:
- Sandbox extension: 90 days (vs. standard 30)
- Complimentary credits: $40,000

My recommended approval (conservative compromise):
- Approve a 60-day extension (one-time) and $25,000 in credits
- Require a signed MOU or PO acknowledging the one-off grant and agreeing to a follow-on commercial evaluation within the period; credits expire at the end of the extension
- Product/solutions will run a short evaluation plan (5 checkpoints) — Engineering to share results with our EPD contact

Attachments: Brightfield usage report (attached) and a draft MOU I can send if you sign off.

Next steps I need from you both:
- Approve or counter my recommendation
- If approved, confirm whether legal needs to draft an addendum; I can start the DocuSign flow once we have signoff

Thanks — Connor

Attachments included to Deal Desk: brightfield_usage_q2.pdf, proposed_mou_brightfield_v2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: one-off sandbox runway waiver & complimentary credits — Brightfield (recommendation)

Connor — thanks for the clear write-up and for the recommended guardrails. I spoke briefly with Aditya and we discussed risk/reward. We’ll approve a one-time concession with conditions.

Approval (executive sign-off):
- Sandbox extension: 60 days (one-time)
- Complimentary credits: $25,000
- Conditions:
  - Require a signed MOU or PO that references this exception and confirms a planned commercial evaluation within the extension window
  - Credits will be time-bound and non-refundable; any overage billed at standard rates
  - Engineering must provide a 5-point evaluation checklist (metrics: latency, P95, token cost, integration stability, and cold-start behavior) at days 14, 30, and 50
  - Deal Desk to flag any production intent before credits are exhausted — we will reevaluate commercial terms at that milestone

Aditya — please confirm accounting/finance will permit the $25k grant and advise on whether we need a simple addendum or legal review. Connor — once Aditya confirms, please send the MOU for Sophie to sign and start the DocuSign link.

Marissa Cole
VP Sales — West
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
